summary: Load older conversation pages through the native timeline cursor and preserve loaded history when paging fails or the live window refreshes.

replay.detail: No persisted projections or replay changes.

compatibility.detail: Uses existing timeline paging and the virtual transcript history contract; adds no wire operation.

downtime.detail: No service restart or coordinated rollout required.

recovery.detail: A failed page retains loaded rows and offers an explicit retry; no persisted state changes.
